holeBearingsHint: Compass bearings (0-360 deg) per hole, tee to green, from OSM golf=hole ways. Tournament composite routing (7,315 yd, par 71): holes 1-9 = West 10-18, holes 10-16 = West 1 and 4-9 (West 2-3 skipped), holes 17-18 = East 17-18. Mapping chains tee-to-green and matches card pars/yardages; West 18 is tagged par 5 in OSM but plays par 4. Holes 11-12 (West 4-5) use different tees from OSM's ways (card 470-530 / 444-459 vs OSM 415 / 516 straight-line), so their bearings are the least certain.
